items.titleZh: 奥康回应哈斯车队签下卡马拉加盟F1 2027
items.summaryZh: 奥康认为卡马拉应得到F1的机会，但认为他不应在2027年没有座位。

media.altZh: 奥康回应哈斯车队签下卡马拉加盟F1 2027 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Esteban Ocon responds to Haas signing Rafael Camara for F1 2027
detailZh: 埃斯蒂班·奥康回应哈斯车队签下拉斐尔·卡马拉参加2027年F1赛事
埃斯蒂班·奥康将在2027年被法拉利青训车队车手拉斐尔·卡马拉取代，并且明年没有真正的F1赛车手位置选择
埃斯蒂班·奥康认为他的哈斯车队替代者拉斐尔·卡马拉应该得到在F1中展示自己的机会，但他觉得不应该没有2027年的赛车手位置
卡马拉的签约在上周得到确认，作为巴西人从F2联赛晋升而来——他目前是联赛的领导者。尽管奥利弗·贝尔曼尚未被哈斯车队官方宣布留队，但美国车队希望延长他的合同。
在2027年的赛车上没有留下任何真正的机会，除非出现任何惊喜的退出，奥康的选择非常有限，这位30岁的车手最有可能签订一份预备合同来保持他的竞技状态——而不是转战其他类别。
奥康坚称他的表现并不是他离开的原因，但再次不愿透露哈斯车队选择不续约的具体原因。
“我无法说太多。我可以说的是，拉法应该得到一次F1的机会。我认为他在其他类别中已经证明了自己非常出色，”他在本周末的美国大奖赛之前说。
“但我不应该同时被排除在F1之外。就是这样。我来到这里是为了尽我所能做好工作，试图最大限度地发挥汽车的性能。”
“正如我所说，我有资格在这里参加一级方程式赛车。有很多原因说明我明年不会在这里，但它们不是性能原因。我在每个类别中都赢得了所有的一切。”
拉斐尔·卡马拉将加入哈斯一级方程式车队参加2027赛季
“我在卡丁车、雷诺方程式、三级方程式、GP3、F1等所有这些类别中都赢得了比赛。仅从体育角度考虑，我有资格参加F1。我相信这不会是我F1生涯的最后一年。”
奥康的焦点是确保他能在哈斯车队的最后几场比赛中继续表现出色，并帮助车队在 制造商锦标赛中保持第七名的位置 - 目前领先奥迪七分。
尽管他在得知自己2026年没有赛车后得到了公众的支持，奥康表示他并不需要来自同行的私人支持——而且事实上也没有收到过。
"当然，我在私底下会和一些家伙聊天，"这位法国人补充道。"比如，兰斯来找我谈过。但我没有收到任何人的消息。
"他们没有给我发短信——在媒体上表示支持。这没关系。毕竟，这并不是终点。我不需要任何车手或什么的支持。那不是我所需要的。对每个人来说，这是一个艰难的世界。
"我们都在经历同样的事情。如果你在三场比赛中表现不佳，你就是最差的。如果你在三场好比赛中表现良好，你就是最好的。所以，这就是这项运动的困难所在。"
detailEn: Esteban Ocon responds to Haas signing Rafael Camara for F1 2027
Esteban Ocon is being replaced by Ferrari junior Rafael Camara for 2027 and has no real options for an F1 drive next year
Esteban Ocon agrees that his Haas replacement Rafael Camara deserves his chance to be in Formula 1, but feels he does not deserve to be without a seat for 2027.

Camara's signing was confirmed last week as the Brazilian steps up from F2 - where he is currently the championship leader. Although Oliver Bearman is yet to be officially announced by Haas as staying at the team, the American outfit is hoping to extend his deal.

With no real opportunities left on the 2027 grid barring any surprise exits, Ocon's options are slim and the 30-year-old is most likely looking at a reserve deal to keep his hand in - rather than making a switch to a different category.
Ocon was adamant that his performances were not the reason for his departure, but once more would not be drawn on the specific reasons why Haas chose not to extend his deal.
"I can't say very much. What I will say is that Rafa deserves a shot in F1. I think he's shown in the categories that he's very good," he said ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.
"But I don't deserve to be out of F1 at the same time. That's it. I'm coming here to do the best job I can, trying to exploit the maximum out of the car.
"As I said, I deserve to be here in Formula 1. There are many circumstances why I'm not here next year. But they are not the performance reasons. I've won everything in every category.
Rafael Camara joins Haas F1 Team for 2027

"I've done in go-karts, in Formula Renault, in Formula 3, in GP3, in F1. In all these categories I've won races. Just thinking from a sports perspective, I deserve to be in F1. I believe that this is not my last year in F1."

Ocon's focus, then, was on ensuring that he could continue to deliver in his final races for Haas and assist the team in its fight to retain seventh in the constructors' championship - it is currently seven points clear of Audi.
Although he'd received public support following the news that he was out of a drive for 2026, Ocon stated that he didn't need private support from his fellow drivers - and nor had he received anyway.
"Of course I talk to some of the guys in private life," the Frenchman added. "Lance came to speak to me for example. But I didn't receive any messages from anyone.

"They haven't texted me - supportive in the press. It's fine. It's not the end anyway. I'm not calling for any support from any drivers or whatever. That's not what I need. It's a difficult world for everybody in a way.
"We are all living in that same thing. If you don't perform for three races, you are the worst. If you perform in three good races, you are the best. So, that's the difficulty of the sport."
keyPointsZh: 卡马拉从F2晋升至F1，目前是F2锦标赛的领导者。
keyPointsEn: Camara is stepping up from F2 to F1, where he is currently the championship leader.

media.altZh: 前F1首席执行官透露纽约是除迈阿密和拉斯维加斯之外考虑的第三个美国城市 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Former F1 CEO reveals third US city targeted alongside Miami and Las Vegas
detailZh: 前F1首席执行官透露第三个美国城市目标是迈阿密和拉斯维加斯之外的城市
前F1首席执行官查斯·凯里（Chase Carey）透露，在Liberty Media收购锦标赛后，纽约被考虑与迈阿密和拉斯维加斯一起举办大奖赛
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
前Formula 1首席执行官查斯·凯里（Chase Carey）透露，在Liberty Media收购锦标赛后，纽约是美国F1考虑举办的新赛事的三个地点之一，与迈阿密和拉斯维加斯并列。
凯里自2017年起担任一级方程式赛车CEO，直到2021年初斯蒂法诺·多梅尼卡利接任。这位72岁的老人加入了在纽约举办的Autosport Business Exchange的强大嘉宾阵容，讨论美国赛车运动的增长、创新和影响力。
Autosport Business Exchange第二次回到纽约市，在曼哈顿汽车展厅汇集了来自赛车、商业和品牌的资深领导者，探讨美国赛车运动的增长。
克里斯蒂安·霍纳自离开奥拉尔·红牛车队以来，首次在此次活动中亮相美国。
其他嘉宾包括七次NASCAR杯系列赛冠军吉米·约翰逊、前一级方程式赛车主席兼首席执行官查斯·凯里、通用汽车的马克·雷乌斯、潘森斯的乔纳森·吉布森和NASCAR的蒂姆·克拉克。
在活动期间，与福克斯商业频道主持人Liz Claman的现场对话中，凯里表示，从第一天起，在美国发展一级方程式赛车就是一个重点。
"美国很重要，不仅仅是因为这里观众规模庞大，它还推动着全球媒体。许多推动娱乐媒体世界的品牌和特许经营权都源自美国。
"我认为他们已经有大约300个合作伙伴了。我想其中超过一半是基于美国的实体。它们可能规模不大，但都是基于美国的。因此，对美国来说，这是一个极其重要的市场。我们需要更大的影响力。我们希望扩大影响力来推动它的发展。但如果我们进入美国，我们只能在一些特定的地点。
"我说，'看，我们的位置需要是标志性的地点，让人们感到震撼。'有三个。我们在奥斯汀有一场精彩的比赛。这是一场棒极了的比赛。我希望这个周末有机会去的人都能享受它。这是一次极好的体验。
“但我们想在此基础上增加更多，我们认为在那个阶段，纽约、迈阿密和拉斯维加斯是我们认为真正适合我们的三个地点。纽约，我们现实地认识到这不可能实现。所以，迈阿密和拉斯维加斯成为了我们认为可以扩大我们的足迹、扩大我们的存在，并将之作为体育在美国的基石的地方。”
迈阿密于2022年加入赛历，拉斯维加斯于2023年加入。两者都签署了长期合同延期，这将使迈阿密至少保持在F1赛历上到2041年，而拉斯维加斯则延续到2037年底。
detailEn: Former F1 CEO reveals third US city targeted alongside Miami and Las Vegas
Former F1 CEO Chase Carey has revealed that New York was considered alongside Miami and Las Vegas for a grand prix race following Liberty Media's takeover
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Former Formula 1 CEO Chase Carey has revealed New York was one of only three places F1 considered for new races in the United States after Liberty Media bought the championship, alongside Miami and Las Vegas.

Carey ran F1 as CEO from 2017 until Stefano Domenicali took over at the start of 2021. The 72-year-old joined an impressive line-up of panellists at the Autosport Business Exchange in New York to discuss the growth, innovation and influence of motorsport in the United States.

Autosport Business Exchange returned to New York City for its second edition, bringing together senior leaders from across motorsport, business and brands at the Manhattan Motorcars showroom to examine racing's growth in America
Christian Horner made his first U.S. appearance at the event since leaving Oracle Red Bull Racing

Other panellists included seven-time NASCAR Cup Series champion Jimmie Johnson, former chairman and CEO of Formula 1 Chase Carey, General Motors' Mark Reuss, Penske's Jonathan Gibson and NASCAR's Tim Clark
During an on-stage conversation with Fox Business anchor Liz Claman at the event, Carey said growing F1 in the United States was a priority from day one.
"The U.S. is important, not just because of the size of the audience here, but it drives global media. A lot of the brands and franchises that drive the entertainment media world come out of the U.S.

"I think they had about 300 partners already. I think over half are U.S.-based entities. They may be little companies, but they're U.S. based. So, the U.S. is an incredibly important market for us. We needed a bigger footprint. We wanted a bigger footprint to grow it. But if we went into the U.S., there are only certain places we could be.

"And I said, 'Look, our locations need to be iconic locations that wow people.' There were three. We have a great race in Austin. It's a fabulous race. I hope everybody who has a chance to go this weekend enjoys it. It's a great experience.

"But we wanted to add to that where we felt we could. But there were only three locations we thought that really made sense for us at that point. It was New York, Miami and Las Vegas. New York, we realistically recognised wasn't going to happen. So, Miami and Las Vegas became places we thought we could expand that footprint, expand our presence and add that as a building block to the sport in the U.S."
Miami joined the calendar in 2022 and Las Vegas in 2023. Both signed long-term contract extensions, which will keep Miami on the F1 calendar until at least 2041 and Vegas through to the end of 2037.
keyPointsZh: 查斯·凯里曾是F1首席执行官。
keyPointsEn: Chase Carey was the CEO of F1.
